[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#reference-architecture-quality-checklist]

# Reference Architecture Quality Checklist

This checklist ensures that reference architectures meet the quality standards and requirements established by the Enterprise Architecture Program (EAP). Use this checklist throughout the creation, review, and maintenance processes.
page_texts.3:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#research-and-planning]

### Research and Planning

- [ ] **Existing Architecture Review**: Researched existing reference architectures to avoid duplication
- [ ] **Stakeholder Identification**: Identified key stakeholders and target audience
- [ ] **Business Case**: Established clear business case and value proposition
- [ ] **Scope Definition**: Clearly defined scope, boundaries, and applicability
- [ ] **Resource Planning**: Confirmed availability of required resources and expertise
page_texts.4:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#standards-alignment]

### Standards Alignment

- [ ] **Enterprise Standards**: Verified alignment with enterprise architecture standards
- [ ] **Industry Standards**: Identified relevant industry standards and frameworks
- [ ] **Technology Standards**: Confirmed alignment with approved technology standards
- [ ] **Governance Alignment**: Ensured alignment with governance frameworks and policies
page_texts.6:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#metadata-and-identification]

### Metadata and Identification

- [ ] **Reference Architecture ID**: Unique ID follows REF-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN} format
- [ ] **Metadata Complete**: All required metadata fields are completed accurately
- [ ] **Tags Appropriate**: Mandatory tags included, optional tags add value
- [ ] **Version Control**: Version numbering follows semantic versioning standards
- [ ] **Status Accuracy**: Status field accurately reflects current state
page_texts.7:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#executive-summary]

### Executive Summary

- [ ] **Purpose Clear**: Purpose statement is clear and compelling
- [ ] **Business Value**: Business value and outcomes are well-articulated
- [ ] **Scope Defined**: Scope and applicability are clearly defined
- [ ] **Stakeholders Identified**: Key stakeholders and audience are specified
- [ ] **Concise Summary**: Executive summary is concise yet comprehensive
page_texts.8:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#architecture-vision-and-objectives]

### Architecture Vision and Objectives

- [ ] **Vision Statement**: Clear architectural vision and desired end state
- [ ] **Strategic Objectives**: Objectives are specific, measurable, and achievable
- [ ] **Business Alignment**: Strong alignment with business strategy and goals
- [ ] **Architectural Principles**: Core principles are clearly stated and justified
- [ ] **Success Criteria**: Clear criteria for measuring architecture success
page_texts.9:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#context-and-constraints]

### Context and Constraints

- [ ] **Business Context**: Business drivers and requirements are thoroughly documented
- [ ] **Technical Context**: Current technical environment and constraints are addressed
- [ ] **Organizational Context**: Organizational factors and capabilities are considered
- [ ] **External Context**: Industry and regulatory factors are documented
- [ ] **Constraint Analysis**: All significant constraints are identified and analyzed
page_texts.10:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#architecture-views-and-models]

### Architecture Views and Models

- [ ] **Business View**: Business architecture view is complete and relevant
- [ ] **Application View**: Application architecture view shows components and relationships
- [ ] **Data View**: Data architecture view addresses data entities and flows
- [ ] **Technology View**: Technology architecture view covers platforms and infrastructure
- [ ] **Security View**: Security architecture view addresses security requirements
- [ ] **View Consistency**: All views are consistent and aligned with each other
page_texts.11:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#component-specifications]

### Component Specifications

- [ ] **Core Components**: All core components are thoroughly specified
- [ ] **Component Interfaces**: Interfaces and APIs are clearly documented
- [ ] **Dependencies**: Component dependencies are identified and documented
- [ ] **Alternatives**: Alternative approaches and trade-offs are discussed
- [ ] **Implementation Details**: Sufficient detail for implementation guidance
page_texts.12:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#implementation-guidelines]

### Implementation Guidelines

- [ ] **Implementation Approach**: Clear methodology and phases are defined
- [ ] **Prerequisites**: All prerequisites are identified and documented
- [ ] **Implementation Steps**: Step-by-step guidance is provided
- [ ] **Migration Considerations**: Migration approach and considerations are addressed
- [ ] **Actionable Guidance**: Guidelines are practical and implementable
page_texts.13:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#deployment-and-operations]

### Deployment and Operations

- [ ] **Deployment Architecture**: Physical deployment models are specified
- [ ] **Operational Requirements**: Monitoring and management requirements are defined
- [ ] **Performance Considerations**: Scalability and performance factors are addressed
- [ ] **Disaster Recovery**: Business continuity approaches are documented
- [ ] **Operational Readiness**: Operational considerations are thoroughly covered
page_texts.14:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#governance-and-compliance]

### Governance and Compliance

- [ ] **Architecture Governance**: Governance framework is clearly defined
- [ ] **Standards Compliance**: Compliance requirements are specified
- [ ] **Risk Management**: Risks are identified with mitigation strategies
- [ ] **Quality Assurance**: Quality metrics and validation approaches are defined
- [ ] **Governance Integration**: Aligns with enterprise governance processes
page_texts.15:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#examples-and-use-cases]

### Examples and Use Cases

- [ ] **Reference Implementations**: Concrete examples are provided
- [ ] **Use Case Scenarios**: Multiple scenarios demonstrate applicability
- [ ] **Lessons Learned**: Insights and recommendations are documented
- [ ] **Success Metrics**: Clear metrics for measuring success are defined
- [ ] **Practical Application**: Examples demonstrate real-world application
page_texts.16:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#related-architectures-and-references]

### Related Architectures and References

- [ ] **Related Architectures**: Links to complementary reference architectures are provided
- [ ] **Standards Alignment**: Related standards (STD-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) are properly referenced
- [ ] **Pattern Integration**: Related patterns (PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###}) are appropriately integrated
- [ ] **Guidance Integration**: Supporting guidance (GUID-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) is properly referenced
- [ ] **Best Practices Integration**: Relevant best practices (BP-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) are appropriately integrated
- [ ] **All Cross-References Valid**: All cross-references use correct ID formats for their artifact type
- [ ] **Dependencies**: Dependencies on other architectures and artifacts are documented
- [ ] **Industry References**: Relevant industry standards and frameworks are cited
- [ ] **Vendor References**: Relevant vendor solutions are appropriately referenced
- [ ] **Reference Accuracy**: All references are accurate and current
page_texts.18:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#architecture-soundness]

### Architecture Soundness

- [ ] **Technical Accuracy**: All technical content is accurate and validated
- [ ] **Architecture Integrity**: Architecture design is sound and consistent
- [ ] **Best Practices**: Industry best practices are incorporated
- [ ] **Technology Alignment**: Technology choices are appropriate and justified
- [ ] **Scalability**: Architecture addresses scalability requirements
page_texts.19:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#diagram-quality]

### Diagram Quality

- [ ] **Diagram Standards**: All diagrams follow established notation standards
- [ ] **Diagram Clarity**: Diagrams are clear, readable, and well-labeled
- [ ] **Multiple Views**: Appropriate architectural views are provided
- [ ] **Diagram Consistency**: Consistent notation and styling across all diagrams
- [ ] **Visual Quality**: High-quality, professional-looking diagrams
page_texts.20:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#implementation-feasibility]

### Implementation Feasibility

- [ ] **Implementable Design**: Architecture design is technically feasible
- [ ] **Resource Requirements**: Resource requirements are realistic and achievable
- [ ] **Technology Maturity**: Recommended technologies are mature and proven
- [ ] **Risk Assessment**: Technical risks are identified and mitigated
- [ ] **Complexity Management**: Architecture complexity is appropriate for context
page_texts.22:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#content-organization]

### Content Organization

- [ ] **Logical Structure**: Content is logically organized and easy to navigate
- [ ] **Section Completeness**: All required sections are present and complete
- [ ] **Information Flow**: Information flows logically from section to section
- [ ] **Cross-References**: Appropriate cross-references and links are provided
- [ ] **Table of Contents**: Clear table of contents for navigation
page_texts.23:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#writing-quality]

### Writing Quality

- [ ] **Clear Language**: Content is written in clear, professional language
- [ ] **Target Audience**: Language is appropriate for target audience
- [ ] **Consistent Terminology**: Terminology is consistent throughout
- [ ] **Grammar and Spelling**: Content is free of grammatical and spelling errors
- [ ] **Concise Expression**: Information is expressed concisely without sacrificing clarity
page_texts.24:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#formatting-and-style]

### Formatting and Style

- [ ] **Markdown Standards**: Proper Markdown formatting is used throughout
- [ ] **Consistent Formatting**: Formatting is consistent across all sections
- [ ] **Professional Appearance**: Document has a professional appearance
- [ ] **Readability**: Document is easy to read and visually appealing
- [ ] **Template Compliance**: Document follows the established template structure
page_texts.25:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#accessibility-and-usability]

### Accessibility and Usability

- [ ] **Easy Navigation**: Document is easy to navigate and find information
- [ ] **Search Friendly**: Content is structured for searchability
- [ ] **Mobile Friendly**: Document renders well on different devices
- [ ] **Print Friendly**: Document can be printed effectively if needed
- [ ] **Link Functionality**: All internal and external links function properly
page_texts.27:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#review-process]

### Review Process

- [ ] **Self-Review**: Author has completed thorough self-review
- [ ] **Peer Review**: Appropriate peer reviewers have reviewed content
- [ ] **Stakeholder Review**: Key stakeholders have reviewed and provided feedback
- [ ] **Technical Review**: Technical experts have validated technical content
- [ ] **Architecture Review**: Architecture review board has approved
page_texts.28:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#review-documentation]

### Review Documentation

- [ ] **Review Feedback**: All review feedback has been documented
- [ ] **Issue Resolution**: All review issues have been addressed
- [ ] **Review Log**: Complete review log with all formal reviews
- [ ] **Approval Evidence**: Formal approval documentation is complete
- [ ] **Change Tracking**: All changes from reviews are documented
page_texts.29:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#compliance-validation]

### Compliance Validation

- [ ] **Standards Compliance**: Compliance with all relevant standards verified
- [ ] **Quality Standards**: Architecture meets established quality standards
- [ ] **Governance Compliance**: Compliance with governance requirements verified
- [ ] **Risk Acceptance**: All identified risks have been appropriately addressed
- [ ] **Final Approval**: Final approval from appropriate authority obtained
page_texts.31:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#version-control]

### Version Control

- [ ] **Change History**: Complete change history is maintained
- [ ] **Version Numbering**: Proper version numbering is used
- [ ] **Change Documentation**: All changes are properly documented
- [ ] **Impact Assessment**: Impact of changes is assessed and documented
- [ ] **Backward Compatibility**: Backward compatibility considerations addressed
page_texts.32:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#ongoing-maintenance]

### Ongoing Maintenance

- [ ] **Review Schedule**: Regular review schedule is established
- [ ] **Update Process**: Process for updates and maintenance is defined
- [ ] **Feedback Integration**: Process for integrating feedback is established
- [ ] **Currency Monitoring**: Process for monitoring currency and relevance is defined
- [ ] **Deprecation Planning**: Process for deprecation and retirement is planned
page_texts.33:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#knowledge-management]

### Knowledge Management

- [ ] **Documentation Repository**: Architecture is properly stored in repository
- [ ] **Search Metadata**: Appropriate metadata for searchability is included
- [ ] **Access Control**: Appropriate access controls are established
- [ ] **Backup and Recovery**: Backup and recovery processes are in place
- [ ] **Knowledge Transfer**: Knowledge transfer processes are documented
page_texts.35:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#quantitative-metrics]

### Quantitative Metrics

- [ ] **Completeness Score**: All sections completed (target: 100%)
- [ ] **Review Coverage**: All required reviews completed (target: 100%)
- [ ] **Stakeholder Approval**: All stakeholders have approved (target: 100%)
- [ ] **Link Validation**: All links functional (target: 100%)
- [ ] **Diagram Quality**: All diagrams meet standards (target: 100%)
page_texts.36:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#qualitative-assessment]

### Qualitative Assessment

- [ ] **Business Value**: Architecture provides clear business value
- [ ] **Technical Excellence**: Architecture demonstrates technical excellence
- [ ] **Usability**: Architecture is usable by target audience
- [ ] **Implementability**: Architecture is implementable in practice
- [ ] **Maintainability**: Architecture can be maintained and updated effectively
page_texts.37:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#success-indicators]

### Success Indicators

- [ ] **Stakeholder Satisfaction**: Stakeholders are satisfied with architecture quality
- [ ] **Implementation Success**: Successful implementations demonstrate architecture value
- [ ] **Adoption Rate**: Architecture is being adopted and used as intended
- [ ] **Feedback Quality**: Positive feedback from users and implementers
- [ ] **Business Impact**: Architecture is delivering intended business impact
page_texts.39:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#certification-criteria]

### Certification Criteria

- [ ] **All Checklists Complete**: All applicable checklist items are completed
- [ ] **Quality Standards Met**: Architecture meets all established quality standards
- [ ] **Review Approval**: All required reviews and approvals are complete
- [ ] **Documentation Complete**: All documentation is complete and accurate
- [ ] **Ready for Publication**: Architecture is ready for publication and use

page_texts.42:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#for-reference-architecture-authors]

### For Reference Architecture Authors

1. Use this checklist throughout the creation process, not just at the end
2. Complete self-assessment before submitting for review
3. Address all checklist items or document reasons for non-compliance
4. Use checklist as a guide for continuous improvement
page_texts.43:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#for-reviewers]

### For Reviewers

1. Use checklist to ensure comprehensive review coverage
2. Document any deviations or exceptions clearly
3. Provide constructive feedback for improvement
4. Validate checklist completion before approving
page_texts.44:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#for-quality-assurance]

### For Quality Assurance

1. Use checklist as basis for quality assessments
2. Track quality metrics and trends over time
3. Identify areas for process improvement
4. Update checklist based on lessons learned
page_texts.45:
[strategy/reference/reference-architecture-quality-checklist.md#continuous-improvement]

## Continuous Improvement

This quality checklist should be regularly reviewed and updated based on:

- Lessons learned from reference architecture implementations
- Feedback from authors, reviewers, and users
- Changes in enterprise standards and requirements
- Evolution of industry best practices and standards
- Technology changes and architectural trends
